items.control_name: Enable Data Access Audit Logs Across All Services
items.description: Admin Activity, Data Access (ADMIN_READ, DATA_READ, DATA_WRITE), and System Event logs must be enabled.
items.current_value: Data Access logs enabled for Cloud Storage and BigQuery; missing for IAM
items.recommended_value: Enable Data Access audit logging for all core services
items.remediation_notes: Update auditConfigs in organization IAM policy to capture all read/write data events.

items.control_name: Centralized Security Log Sink to Cloud Storage / PubSub SIEM
items.description: An aggregated log sink must export security logs to a dedicated, immutable archive bucket or Pub/Sub SIEM feed.
items.current_value: Aggregated org sink 'siem-security-export' active -> Pub/Sub topic
items.recommended_value: Active aggregated sink with Bucket Lock / retention policy >= 365 days
items.remediation_notes: Verify Pub/Sub dead-letter queue metrics and SIEM ingestion SLA.

items.control_name: Security Command Center (SCC) Premium Tier & Continuous Monitoring
items.description: Security Command Center must be active at Org level with Event Threat Detection and Security Health Analytics.
items.current_value: SCC Enterprise Tier active; Event Threat Detection enabled
items.recommended_value: SCC Enterprise/Premium active across all organization folders

items.control_name: VPC Flow Logs Enabled with Appropriate Sampling Rate
items.description: VPC Flow Logs should be enabled on all production subnets with metadata annotation.
items.current_value: Enabled on 8 of 10 subnets (aggregation interval 5s, sample rate 0.5)
items.remediation_notes: Enable flow logs on remaining subnets for network forensic readiness.
